_readme: The people tools/blender/make_people.py builds from MakeHuman (CC0). Each: MakeHuman targets (path under makehuman/data/targets, no extension) and their weights, mixed onto the base mesh; then fitted to our skeleton and body envelope. `outfit`: the garments he wears and their colours (tools/blender/clothes.py makes and drapes them, and bakes each a pixel texture). Output: assets/people/<id>.glb, <id>_<garment>.png, and <id>.json (what was done). `face`: how he looks, for the image model (tools/faces/paint_face.py) to paint onto his head. A person with "source": "tripo" is a Tripo model (assets/people/tripo/<id>.glb) fitted by tools/blender/fit_tripo.py instead; he comes dressed, so his outfit is empty.

outlaw.note: A hard man in his late thirties: lean, wiry, a little weathered.
outlaw.face: a hard, weathered frontier man in his late thirties, sun-darkened skin with a few lines, heavy dark brows over deep-set watchful eyes, a strong straight nose, a thick dark moustache over the lip, a few days' stubble on the jaw, dark hair at the temples and sideburns

stranger.note: The painting's man by image-to-3D (tools/characters/, Tripo), fitted by tools/blender/fit_tripo.py: he comes dressed, hat and all.
stranger.face: a weathered frontier gunman of about forty: deep-set dark eyes, heavy brows, a thick dark drooping moustache and stubble, long dark hair to his collar
